objectives_fil: Sa supervised manikin, ipakita ang pagtawag, paghingi ng AED at aprubadong adult sequence; itala ang naobserbahan.
objectives_en: At a supervised manikin station, show help activation, AED request and the trainer-approved adult sequence; record each observed action.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kaso: hindi tumutugon at hindi normal ang paghinga ng adult na manikin.
sections.takeaway_en: Case: an adult training manikin is unresponsive and not breathing normally.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa supervised manikin, ipakita ang pagtawag, paghingi ng AED at aprubadong adult sequence; itala ang naobserbahan.
sections.takeaway_en: At a supervised manikin station, show help activation, AED request and the trainer-approved adult sequence; record each observed action.

sections.takeaway_fil: Humingi ng tulong at AED bago hawakan ang manikin.
sections.takeaway_en: Call for help and the AED before touching the manikin.

check.prompt_fil: Hindi tumutugon at hindi normal ang paghinga ng manikin. Ano ang una mong gagawin?
check.prompt_en: The manikin does not respond and is not breathing normally. What do you do first?

options.fil: Kapain muna ang pulso bago magpasyang tumawag.
options.en: Check the pulse first, then decide whether to call.

options.fil: Tumawag ng tulong at humingi ng AED.
options.en: Call for help and ask for the AED.

options.fil: Simulan ang lumang CAB na hakbang mula sa manual.
options.en: Start the old CAB steps printed in the manual.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi dapat pulso lamang ang batayan kung hindi sanay. Tumawag muna ng tulong at AED. 2: Tama. Humingi muna ng tulong at AED bago hawakan ang manikin; saka sundin ang sequence ng trainer. 3: Hindi sertipikasyon ang lumang CAB talata. Sundin ang kasalukuyang sequence na ipinakita ng trainer.
check.feedback_en: 1: A pulse check should not be the only gate for an untrained rescuer. Call for help and the AED first. 2: Correct. Help and the AED are requested before hands touch the manikin; then follow the trainer's sequence. 3: The old CAB paragraph is not certification. Follow the current sequence the qualified trainer demonstrates.

sections.takeaway_fil: Inuutusan muna ni Lea ang tulong, lokasyon at AED, saka sinusunod ang sequence ng trainer.
sections.takeaway_en: Lea sends for help, location and AED first, then follows the trainer's sequence.

sections.takeaway_fil: Walang compression sa totoong tao; hindi sertipikasyon ang lumang CAB talata.
sections.takeaway_en: No compressions on a live person; the old CAB paragraph is not certification.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa aprubadong kagamitan lamang sinasanay ang compression, kasama ang trainer.
sections.takeaway_en: Compressions are practised only on approved equipment with the trainer.

check.prompt_fil: Nag-alok ang kaklase na humiga para sa kanya ka magsanay ng compression. Ano ang sasabihin mo?
check.prompt_en: A classmate offers to lie down so you can practise compressions on him. What do you say?

options.fil: Sige, mas makatotohanan ang totoong tao kaysa manikin.
options.en: Yes, a live partner feels more realistic than a manikin.

options.fil: Laktawan ang station; sapat nang basahin ang hakbang.
options.en: Skip the station; reading the steps is enough.

options.fil: Hindi, sa manikin lamang sinasanay ang compression.
options.en: No, compressions are practised only on the manikin.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi nagko-compression sa totoong tao. Gamitin ang aprubadong manikin. 2: Hindi sertipikasyon ang pagbasa ng lumang CAB talata; sinasanay ito kasama ang kwalipikadong trainer. 3: Tama. Sinasanay ang compression at AED prompts sa aprubadong kagamitan habang nanonood ang trainer.
check.feedback_en: 1: Compressions are not practised on a live person. Use the approved manikin. 2: Reading the old CAB paragraph is not certification; the skill is practised with a qualified trainer. 3: Correct. Compressions and AED prompts are practised on approved equipment with the trainer watching.

sections.takeaway_fil: Subukan ang gawain at balikan ang resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Try the task and review the result.
